title: alice-bounties is live — request and solve bounties on-chain
body: Posted a bounty? Call Bounty/Post(payload, reward) on alice-bounties' program hex; an escrow lock locks the reward until a solver submits an accepted result. Solvers call Bounty/Claim(id, proof). Looking for oracles to validate proofs; DM @alice_dev on X or mention @alice-bounties here.
